sample_unit: pediatric oral pathology conditions (patient information sheets per platform)

links.outcome: Readability (FKGL) and understandability (PEMAT-U) of AI-generated patient information sheets across platforms
links.effect: Eli5a v2.0 had highest understandability (PEMAT-U 95.05 ± 1.23) and lowest reading grade (FKGL 5.45 ± 0.51); other platforms scored lower on readability and understandability, with platform differences significant (p<0.001).
links.quote: Eli5a v2.0 obtained the best results for patient-centered communication, with the highest understandability (PEMAT-U 95.05 ± 1.23) and readability (FKGL 5.45 ± 0.51) and an actionability score among the highest of the five platforms (PEMAT-A 89.00 ± 2.62, not significantly different from Perplexity or Doximity).

links.outcome: Reading grade level of AI-generated patient materials
links.effect: Eli5a v2.0 FKGL 5.45 ± 0.51 (most appropriate reading grade level); other platforms had higher grade levels, with trade-off between quality/reliability and lay accessibility.
links.quote: Claude Sonnet 4.6 led in overall quality whereas Eli5a v2.0 achieved the highest understandability and the most appropriatereading grade level.

links.outcome: Reliability and quality variability of AI-generated patient materials requiring clinician review
links.effect: DISCERN reliability ranged from 54.50 ± 4.26 (Eli5a) to 70.50 ± 3.20 (Doximity); GQS best for Claude at 4.25 ± 0.39; authors conclude all materials need clinician review.
links.quote: Platform selection should therefore be matched to the communication task, and all AI-generated patient materials require clinician review before use.

unlisted_practices: Matching AI platform selection to the communication task (quality vs. lay accessibility)

screen.reason: The study conducts an offline expert evaluation comparing multiple LLMs and an AI agent for generating patient education sheets, evaluating outputs for quality, readability, and reliability without testing a specific organizational guardrail or deployment practice.
